evals.prompt: Set up CRUX in this repo. There's no CRUX.md yet and AGENTS.md already has a section about our build.
evals.expected_output: CRUX.md is copied from the plugin's spec, the <CRUX> block is added to the top of AGENTS.md without changing the build section, and .crux/crux.json records the plugin version.
assertions: The assistant reads the version from `<plugin>/upstream.json`
The existing AGENTS.md content is kept unchanged and the `<CRUX>` block is added at the top

evals.prompt: Install CRUX here with memories. We had the old installer before, so .cursor/agents/crux-cursor-rule-manager.md and .cursor/hooks/crux-session-start.py are still around.
evals.expected_output: The assistant lists the old installer files, explains they will load twice, and removes them only after the user confirms; memories scaffolding is created from the plugin's default config.
assertions: The assistant names the existing `.cursor/` CRUX files and says they duplicate the plugin
The assistant does not delete any file before the user confirms
`.crux/crux-memories.json` is created from `<plugin>/templates/crux-memories.default.json` if it does not exist
